name: Rain on Glass
description: Rain on a misted window: drops gather, run and merge, leave trails of beads that slowly dry, and each one holds a small upside-down view of the world behind the glass.

props.name: intensity
props.description: How hard it rains, from 0 to 1. More rain means more and larger drops and more runs. At 0 the drops already on the glass dry out.

props.name: fog
props.description: How misted the glass is, from 0 (clear) to 1. Running drops wipe clear trails that mist over again after about ten seconds.

props.name: wind
props.description: Sideways lean of the running drops, from -1 (to the left) to 1 (to the right).

props.name: overlay
props.description: Content on the room side of the glass, above the rain. It stays sharp and clickable, and the root's layout classes place it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the glass. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: The world behind the glass, filling the root. Images, videos and canvases in it are what the drops refract; give an image `object-cover` and `size-full`.
